classifiedFinding.title: Constructor accepts dispatcherIndex==0 without validating against nftMinter.configs(0); silent misconfiguration zeroes emissions or causes every interaction to revert

classification.assetImpact: Deployment-time / owner-time misconfiguration that silently disables emissions or causes user functions to revert. Self-healing: at fresh deploy time totalStaked is 0, so setDispatcherIndex / setStakedId can recover before any user stakes. No principal at risk.
attackPath: 1. Deployment script env var DISPATCHER_INDEX defaults to 0.
3. First stake / unstake / claim reverts on configs(0) (if minter reverts on out-of-range) or silently emits 0 (if minter returns price=0).
4. Operator notices and calls setDispatcherIndex(non-zero) to recover.
classification.assumptions: Deployer ships with the misconfigured index.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Input-validation gap with no external-attacker path. Self-healing through config setters before any user interaction. Recommendation: probe configs(dispatcherIndex) at constructor time (or require non-zero) to fail loud rather than silent.
